text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ooouch...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, looks like I messed up pretty
badly. The
doctor was impressed I wasn't
crying from the
pain.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I was gonna cry, the doctor's
scary face
was waaay more likely to
make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha... haha, ha...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm... You were supposed to laugh at
that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. Is your overwhelming
positivity
on vacation?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...We have another race coming up too.
If I don't
push myself here, then where
else?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know what we have to do now,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know what we have to do now,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What? No, I'm saying I should push
mysel—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A-all right, all right! Fine! No need to go
all angry
parent on me!
choice_data_list: 無理なんてさせられないッ！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, it wasn't supposed to be like
this... I said
way too many things that are
out of character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she seems unhappy with the
decision,
Nice Nature gives in and
decides to focus on her
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Of course! I'll be right as rain.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ngh! O-ow!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Why does it have to hurt now? I
look so
lame.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature's injury is serious, so I
decide that she
shouldn't push herself
right now and make her
take some time
off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I stop here, it'll just push my goals
even further
away.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heh, there's the confidence I'm used to.
I'm glad
you're back to your usual self.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All righty then! Let's quickly get this
injury healed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With renewed motivation, Nice Nature
works on
her recovery. Soon after, she
gets back to
training.
